summary: Execution nodes for the operator are installed from an install bundle; custom Receptor certificates need the otherName SAN 1.3.6.1.4.1.2312.19.1 and the host FQDN in the SAN, and wildcard certificates aren't supported.
questions: Can I use a wildcard certificate for receptor nodes?
What SAN does a receptor certificate need?
How do I add execution nodes to the AAP Operator?
